problem: Pinned local-cluster faucet unconditionally renders funding destinations with Cardano.Address.bech32; cardano-cli rejects a Byron destination in that representation.
observed_result: Baseline486 HTTP and1059 internals pass; basic live transfer/restoration pass; families fails on initial Icarus faucet funding; all owned wallets cleaned up.
proposal: For Byron sources only, create a fresh owned Shelley funding wallet, fund its valid Shelley address through the existing real faucet, construct/sign/submit an exact100000000-lovelace payment to the original base58 Byron destination, verify body/witnesses independently and confirm exact Byron output through node UTxO query. Then execute the unchanged funded legacy payment/migration assertions.
reason_for_approval: Personal working agreement requires review before a different approach after a failed test; replacing direct faucet funding with a real on-chain Shelley-to-Byron bridge changes the funding approach.
